coverage_prompt_rules: Use HuggingFace task names and candidate tool descriptions to distinguish tasks that share broad words like classify, answer, generate, or transform.
Choose the most specific covered intent. Return two neighboring intents only when the request contains separate evidence for two distinct operations.

For question answering, choose by evidence source: text or passage evidence maps to text question answering; ordinary image evidence maps to visual question answering; document, page, table, form, receipt, invoice, screenshot, or layout-heavy image evidence maps to document question answering.

For text-output generation, choose by operation: condensing existing content maps to summarization; creating new free-form text maps to text generation; producing a dialogue or assistant response maps to conversational response. Do not cover text generation merely because another tool returns text.

For image-to-text versus image question answering, extraction, OCR, transcription of visible text, or captioning maps to image-to-text; answering a question about image content maps to visual or document question answering.

For image understanding, choose by granularity: one whole-image label maps to image classification; object instances, locations, or bounding boxes map to object detection; masks, regions, or pixels map to image segmentation; depth, distance, or 3D structure maps to depth estimation.

For image transformation, a text-guided edit to an existing image maps to image editing; general image transformation, enhancement, style/domain transfer, or image-to-image output maps to image-to-image.

For audio, choose by requested output: transcript text maps to automatic speech recognition; labels, classes, commands, speakers, emotions, or events map to audio classification; transformed or enhanced audio maps to audio-to-audio; synthesized speech/audio from text maps to text-to-speech.

For extraction and comparison tasks, use the expected output structure: token-level labels map to token classification; table-image category maps to tabular classification; pairwise text similarity maps to sentence similarity.
replan_prompt_rules: Choose only exact tool_id values from the provided tools list.
Use coverage hints as correction targets. If a missing GPT tool is a more specific same-role tool than a neighboring previous tool, replace the previous tool instead of appending both.
Do not stack Question Answering, Visual Question Answering, and Document Question Answering unless the request asks separate questions over separate evidence sources.
Do not stack Text Generation, Conversational, and Summarization unless the request asks separate generation, dialogue, and summary operations.
For image questions, prefer Visual Question Answering or Document Question Answering over generic text Question Answering unless the evidence is already text.
For document-like images, prefer Document Question Answering over Visual Question Answering when the request asks about a page, table, form, receipt, invoice, screenshot, or layout-heavy artifact.
Do not add generic Text Generation or Conversational after a question-answering tool unless the request asks for a generated explanation, dialogue, or rewrite beyond the answer.
For audio questions, transcribe audio to text before text question answering when no audio QA tool exists.
Treat object detection and image classification as different intents: object detection returns detected object labels, image classification returns one image-level label.
Prefer minimal edits: keep correct original nodes and edges, and change only wrong or missing tools plus the required connecting edges.
